transcripts.onepager_promise: Drafts answers to supplier questions from the published RFQ pack, and routes anything new to a clarification every bidder sees
transcripts.prompt: A bidder on the transformer RFQ asks if they can deliver all 24 units in two lots instead of three. What should I tell them?
transcripts.assistant_response:
Tell the bidder that the RFQ requires three lots of 8 units each, delivered to Central Stores. Lot dates are set at award from each bidder's quoted lead time.

They can still propose two lots, but only as a **variant bid under section 5.3**, and it must come alongside a compliant three-lot bid. Their two-lot offer can't replace the standard bid.

Suggested reply (draft for your approval):

> Thank you for your question. RFQ-3301 specifies delivery of 24 units in three lots of 8 to Central Stores, with lot dates set at award from your quoted lead time. A two-lot plan may be submitted as a variant bid under section 5.3, provided you also submit a compliant three-lot bid.

Nothing has been sent. The reply goes out through the supplier portal once you approve it. The RFQ closes 4 November 2026, six days from now.

transcripts.onepager_promise: Scores every bid on price, lead time, quality and sustainability and explains the ranked recommendation for the award panel
transcripts.prompt: The transformer bids are in. How do they score, and who should the award panel pick?
transcripts.assistant_response:
**Recommendation: Brightwater Transformers ($648,000), ranked first at 96.2 points.** The award panel makes the final decision.

| Rank | Supplier | Price | Lead time | Quality | Sustainability | Score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Brightwater Transformers | $648,000 | 9 wks | Complete | 9/10 | **96.2** |
| 2 | Halden Transformer Works | $630,000 | 10 wks | Complete | 6/10 | **92.6** |
| 3 | Kelso Electrical Supply | $612,000 | 13 wks | Incomplete | 2/10 | **75.8** |

Weights are price 50, lead time 20, quality 20, sustainability 10.

- **Brightwater** leads on lead time, complete documents, and sustainability (30% recycled core steel, environmental declaration).
- **Halden** is $18,000 cheaper than Brightwater and scores 3.7 points lower.
- **Kelso** is the lowest price, but its type test certificate for the offered design is missing and its lead time is longest.

No supplier has been notified, and nothing has been awarded.
